517	// placementPicker adapts selectPlacement's messages to the calling verb. The
518	// picker logic is identical for every consumer (dedupe by host, honor an
519	// explicit selector, prompt only when there's a real choice); only the words
520	// differ, so they're passed in rather than duplicated per command.
521	type placementPicker struct {
522		// selector names the non-interactive way to choose a cluster, as the user
523		// would type it (e.g. `--cluster`). Interpolated into the no-terminal error
524		// so the pointer names a flag the calling command actually accepts.
525		selector string
526		// title is the interactive single-select's prompt.
527		title string
528		// action names the operation in the cancellation message, capitalized
529		// ("Clone", "Remote update") — handleFormCancellation prints
530		// "<action> cancelled."
531		action string
532	}
533	
534	// selectCloneTarget resolves which mirror placement to clone from, with the
535	// clone verb's wording. See selectPlacement for the selection rules.
536	func selectCloneTarget(cmd *cobra.Command, placements []coreapi.ResolvedPlacement, clusterFlag string) (coreapi.ResolvedPlacement, error) {
537		return selectPlacement(cmd, placements, clusterFlag, placementPicker{
538			selector: "--cluster",
539			title:    "This repo is mirrored on more than one cluster — pick one to clone from",
540			action:   "Clone",
541		})
542	}
543	
544	// selectPlacement resolves which mirror placement a verb should act on. With one
545	// placement it returns it directly. With an explicit clusterSel it picks the
546	// matching one (or errors listing the available hosts). With more than one and no
547	// selector it prompts interactively, failing fast with a p.selector pointer when
548	// there's no terminal.
549	func selectPlacement(cmd *cobra.Command, placements []coreapi.ResolvedPlacement, clusterSel string, p placementPicker) (coreapi.ResolvedPlacement, error) {
550		// Dedupe by cluster host: one placement per cluster is what a caller acts on,
551		// and the same host appearing twice would only confuse the picker. Key on the
552		// case-folded host — DNS is case-insensitive, so a selector value differing
553		// only in case from the API's ClusterHost must still match (the alternative is
554		// a misleading "not mirrored on ..." after a successful lookup + dial).
555		byHost := make(map[string]coreapi.ResolvedPlacement, len(placements))
556		hosts := make([]string, 0, len(placements))
557		for _, p := range placements {
558			key := strings.ToLower(p.ClusterHost)
559			if _, seen := byHost[key]; seen {
560				continue
561			}
562			byHost[key] = p
563			hosts = append(hosts, key)
564		}
565		sort.Strings(hosts)
566	
567		if clusterSel != "" {
568			match, ok := byHost[strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(clusterSel))]
569			if !ok {
570				return coreapi.ResolvedPlacement{}, fmt.Errorf("repo is not mirrored on %q; available: %s", clusterSel, strings.Join(hosts, ", "))
571			}
572			return match, nil
573		}
574	
575		if len(hosts) == 1 {
576			return byHost[hosts[0]], nil
577		}
578	
579		if !interactive.CanPromptInteractively() {
580			return coreapi.ResolvedPlacement{}, fmt.Errorf("repo is mirrored on %d clusters; pass %s to choose one of: %s", len(hosts), p.selector, strings.Join(hosts, ", "))
581		}
582	
583		options := make([]huh.Option[string], len(hosts))
584		for i, h := range hosts {
585			options[i] = huh.NewOption(mirrorCellLabel(byHost[h]), h)
586		}
587		var selected string
588		form := NewAccessibleForm(
589			huh.NewGroup(
590				huh.NewSelect[string]().
591					Title(p.title).
592					Options(options...).
593					Value(&selected),
594			),
595		)
596		if err := form.RunWithContext(cmd.Context()); err != nil {
597			// handleFormCancellation prints "<action> cancelled." and returns nil for a
598			// Ctrl+C / cancelled-context abort. Surface that as a SilentError so the
599			// caller stops instead of falling through to act on a zero-value target
600			// (the `entire:///gh/...` empty-host bug) without main.go reprinting the
601			// message handleFormCancellation already wrote; a real form error propagates.
602			if cerr := handleFormCancellation(cmd.ErrOrStderr(), p.action, err); cerr != nil {
603				return coreapi.ResolvedPlacement{}, cerr
604			}
605			return coreapi.ResolvedPlacement{}, NewSilentError(fmt.Errorf("%s cancelled", strings.ToLower(p.action)))
606		}
607		match, ok := byHost[selected]
608		if !ok {
609			// The form succeeded but handed back a host that is not on offer. Nothing
610			// has been printed here, so this must NOT be a SilentError — main.go
611			// suppresses those, and the command would exit non-zero with no message.
612			return coreapi.ResolvedPlacement{}, fmt.Errorf("no cluster selected from the %d offered", len(hosts))
613		}
614		return match, nil
615	}
616	
617	// mirrorCellLabel is the human label for a mirror placement in the clone picker:
618	// the physical cell and jurisdiction when known, always anchored by the cluster
619	// host that goes into the clone URL.
620	func mirrorCellLabel(p coreapi.ResolvedPlacement) string {
621		cell := strings.TrimSpace(p.Cell.Or(""))
622		jur := strings.TrimSpace(p.Jurisdiction.Or(""))
623		switch {
624		case cell != "" && jur != "":
625			return fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s) — %s", cell, jur, p.ClusterHost)
626		case cell != "":
627			return fmt.Sprintf("%s — %s", cell, p.ClusterHost)
628		default:
629			return p.ClusterHost
630		}
631	}

No — for **that exact command** we absolutely know the cluster. The full `entire://aws-eu-central-1.entire.io/gh/...` URL names the cluster, so clone parses it out (`parseMirrorCloneURL` → `aws-eu-central-1.entire.io`), goes straight to that cluster's session/login, and runs `git clone`. **No picker at all** — no 7 choices.

The 7-cluster picker only appears for the **bare shorthand** form:

## Problem
`entire repo clone` failed hard when the caller lacked a usable session. Two shapes:
- Any control-plane path dumped the raw ogen-wrapped chain (`resolve mirror placements: security "BearerAuth": … expired; run entire login`).
- A repo on **another region's cluster** failed with `fatal: no auth context for cluster <host>` from `git-remote-entire` (which can't prompt), because clone auth is **cluster-scoped** — the helper needs a local context whose `CoreURL` is in the target cluster's advertised `core_urls`, not just any active login.

## What changed
1. **Clean re-auth message (every control-plane command).** `auth.ReauthMessage` + `renderCoreError`/`runCoreClient` surface only the actionable `run entire login` hint instead of the wrapper-prefixed chain.
2. **Active-context precondition** for the `/gh/` placements lookup: prompt inline login when interactive, clean hint + non-zero exit otherwise.
3. **Cluster-aware precondition** (the fix for the cross-region case), wired into all three URL forms — full `entire://`, `--cluster`, and shorthand after placement selection. Probes the **target cluster** via `ResolveControlPlaneTargetForCluster`; when no eligible session exists, offers to `entire login --server <core>` for that cluster's region (a picker when several cores are trusted) and continues in-process. Non-interactive → clean hint naming the region. Ambiguous-context (`entire auth use`) and discovery failures are surfaced verbatim. Adds `clusterdiscovery.ErrNoEligibleContext`/`ErrAmbiguousContext` sentinels for clean classification.
4. **Home-region default in the placement picker.** A repo mirrored across many clusters no longer lists all of them: `selectCloneTarget` narrows placements to the caller's home jurisdiction (read locally from the login JWT's `home_jurisdiction` claim) before prompting, so a single home-region placement auto-selects. Best-effort — unknown/unmatched home shows all as before; `--cluster` bypasses the filter.

## Not doing
No central main.go catch / re-exec (that's #1794's `cli_upgrade_required` shape). `ENTIRE_TOKEN` runs skip the precondition (the helper validates the bearer itself).

## Testing
`ReauthMessage`, `renderCoreError` noise-strip, `ensureCloneSession` (7 cases), `ensureClusterCloneSession` (11 cases: usable / expired / no-eligible ×TTY×single/multi / ambiguous / discovery / decline / login-error / env-token), `preferHomeJurisdiction` + `selectCloneTarget` home-region default, RunE wiring (full-URL + `--cluster` forward the right host), clusterdiscovery sentinels. Full `cli` + `auth` + `clusterdiscovery` suites, `golangci-lint`, `gofmt` all green. Manual: cross-region `entire://` clone offers region login → continues; piped → clean hint, exit 1.
